claims.originating_goal: Make standard StegSocials preparation actually help prepare posts by reading a selected ERL artifact from the current device-local KV, verifying its stored bytes, and producing an editable platform-shaped draft without any AI-provider or social-provider call.
expected_evidence: ERL content recovered from device-local kv_files
ERL content SHA-256 and size verified before drafting
platform-shaped draft populated into editable preparation surface
ERL authority remains referenced rather than duplicated
standard Save draft to My KV exact-readback path remains intact
collision_boundaries: Do not mutate ERL source content
Do not claim deterministic local extraction is generative AI
Do not call external AI providers
Do not cross into premium automated/scheduled publication
Do not weaken exact stored-byte verification for saved drafts
claims.next_task_after_release: Expand the same preparation helper to provider-backed KV ERL instances and optionally add governed Ecosystem Chat refinement as a separate source-aware enhancement without making provider publication standard.
